issue.title: What happens when communication is disconnected
issue.body:
Using mavsdk as an autopilot server, what would happen when communication is disconnected?

Where can I get the exception handling description?

THX.

comments.body: I don't know, it's a good question. What are you trying to do or solve?

I have a similar issue: When using a Cube Orange connected via USB serial communication and the USB cable is plugged out my MAVSDK based software is unable to reconnect when the USB cable is re-inserted. Is it possible to get access to the Connection object and perform a Stop/Start call? I use the add_any_connection method but there is no remove_any_connection in case the communication dies. Or am I missing something?

@paulholmstedt what you could do is to destruct `Mavsdk` and create it again. `Mavsdk` would take the connections down with itself.

However, I agree, that an `remove_any_connection` might be nice.
Yer that would be a good option. It would be like the new subscription handle.
Could we also add a callback that you can register for when the system is disconnected, so you can perform graceful disconnect operations, or prompt the user that the system is no longer there?

@Ryanf55 so you would want the equivalent of [Mavsdk::subscribe_on_new_system](https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/cpp/api_reference/classmavsdk_1_1_mavsdk.html#classmavsdk_1_1_mavsdk_1a5b7c958ad2e4529dc7b950ab26618575) but `subscribe_on_lost_system`?

What about using [System::subscribe_is_connected](https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/cpp/api_reference/classmavsdk_1_1_system.html#classmavsdk_1_1_system_1aae68747c23976fa7eb63ec0762493263) instead?

> [@Ryanf55](https://github.com/Ryanf55) so you would want the equivalent of [Mavsdk::subscribe_on_new_system](https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/cpp/api_reference/classmavsdk_1_1_mavsdk.html#classmavsdk_1_1_mavsdk_1a5b7c958ad2e4529dc7b950ab26618575) but `subscribe_on_lost_system`?
> 
> What about using [System::subscribe_is_connected](https://mavsdk.mavlink.io/main/en/cpp/api_reference/classmavsdk_1_1_system.html#classmavsdk_1_1_system_1aae68747c23976fa7eb63ec0762493263) instead?

That works!
